decisions.decision: Build everything now and hold back only the parts that need the Pro course on sale. (1) Use cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts with roomSettings() from T-223 to create one weekly Zoom Pro meeting (type 8) called 'Tantra Pro Weekly Coaching': Tuesdays at 11:00 America/New_York, 60 minutes, registration on, cap 98. Store its join link in a config key PRO_COACHING_URL so the Pro course home reads it once T-071 ships. Add a probe check. (2) Write the WhatsApp moderation rota in the task log: Amal leads, Nelbin and Bhaskar alternate weekly, with daily check times, an escalation path and a starter rules list. It goes live when T-040 does. (3) Build the weekly newsletter: a Backlinko-voice template drafted from the coaching call notes, sent through Resend or Tantra (no Beehiiv). Dry-run it to [email] as 'Adi test'. Then set the task to blocked on T-071 for the live link and the first member send.
decisions.why: T-071 is not on sale yet, so the work that waits on it waits, but the rest can be built. T-223 already makes meetings on our own Zoom Pro account. Tuesday stays clear of the Wed to Fri cohort (weekly-cohort-schedule). The 98 cap follows zoom-100-room-limit. No Beehiiv per T-260. Test identity from owner-decisions-2026-10-06.
